diabetes_source.preparation: scripts/prepare_diabetes.py: first encounter per patient, death/hospice discharges excluded, adverse=readmitted<30, exposure=time_in_hospital, 69,990 rows, adverse rate 0.0898

learner_spec.logit: UnifiedLogisticLearner(l2=0.45) as in all earlier studies
learner_spec.gbdt: sklearn 1.6.1 HistGradientBoostingClassifier(max_iter=50, learning_rate=0.1, max_leaf_nodes=8, min_samples_leaf=10, l2_regularization=1.0, early_stopping=False); constant prediction if a training set has one class

study_A.question: does the EVPI floor and the real-label ordering (information-greedy > DC-PRISM in captured H_pre) hold when the downstream learner is gradient boosting?
study_A.primary: real-label credit groups, boosting learner: DC selection gap and DC minus TargetVar-greedy; 8 groups x 2 = 16 tests
study_A.floor_criterion: descriptive: range of group-mean EVPI vs range of group-mean H_pre under each learner

study_B.replay_metric: ALC-Brier, ten rounds, as supplement-v5 study H

study_C.approximation: lower side: two-leader normal EVPI s*phi(D/s)-D*Phi(-D/s); upper side: E max over all sets of independent normals with the replicate means and s.d.s minus the best mean (ignores positive correlation); bracket coverage of measured group-mean EVPI reported
study_C.outputs: state-level Spearman with measured EVPI (H_post - plug-in H_pre), group-level R^2 and ratio range, per learner; descriptive

inference.method: paired one-sample t on independent units; Bonferroni simultaneous t intervals and global Holm within each registered family

stopping: fixed sizes; no interim looks; no additional seeds after results
